modalLead: A correction to the keyboard cursor in Config. Moving through a list with the arrow keys marks the row you are on — on Pages & tags it was marking every widget in the list at once, from the moment the tab opened.

items.text: One row at a time carries the keyboard cursor. Opening Pages & tags lit up every widget sitting between your categories in the accent colour the cursor uses, so the list looked like a dozen rows were selected before a key had been touched — and the row you actually moved to was impossible to pick out among them. The mark now sits on one row, the one you are on.
